about: The hub's island (docs/milestones/hub-rework.md, HR2): a magic island in the void, its coast of bays and points, seven cracks running in from it, kept 110 px clear of everything the room's scene places (tools/ground_shape.py reads hub.tscn); the void round it and the cracks are holes (HR-H2: a body falls in). tools/ground_shape.py draws hub_ground.tscn and its art from this.
